account_id.description: The account ID the SSI is attached to. If money is paid to the account details, this account will be credited.

account_number.description: The account number to use when adding funds to the account.

account_number_type.description: The type of account number provided (e.g. account number of IBAN).

account_holder_name.description: The name of the account used to make a payment.

bank_name.description: The name of the bank the account is held with.

bank_address.description: The address of the bank the account is held with.

bank_country.description: The 2 digit ISO country code where the bank is based.

currency.description: The currency that should be sent to these account details.

payment_type.description: The type of payment that can be made into the account details provided. Regular - a local scheme such as Faster Payments in the UK. Priority - a priority payment e.g. FEDwire or Swift.

routing_code.description: The particular routing code for this account number.

created_at.description: The date-time the SSI was added to the account.

updated_at.description: The date-time the SSI was last updated on the account.
